question: During the Nuakhai festival of Sambalpur in Odisha, the first offering of Nabanna (new rice) is traditionally made to which deity?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maa Samaleswari**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The **Nuakhai festival** is an important agrarian festival celebrated prominently in the western region of Odisha, particularly in the **Sambalpur district**.
 
• During Nuakhai, the first offering of the **Nabanna** (newly harvested rice) is made to **Maa Samaleswari**, the presiding deity of the region.
